messages:
elaine: Need a tight async on private deploy roadmap decisions: slimline packaging, upgrade lanes, and customer-managed networking before next field workshop.
jasper: Short bullets pls. We need to lock installer profiles and acceptable upgrade downtime.
maria: Field asks: slimline = no relay, minimal ops; ops = relay + support hooks. They want a copy-paste allowlist and a NetOps one-pager.
frank: Infra note: minor patches = rolling operator upgrades (short drains, ~30s/node); majors = explicit migration + maintenance window. KV cache compatibility only for minor bumps.
jasper: Recommend CLI-first alpha for faster iteration. Preflight should validate egress, DNS, TLS to control-plane and block on failure with remediation text.
netops: We'll produce the one-pager: egress endpoints, TLS SNI expectations, port 443 test script. Security needs to review allowlist wording.
maria: Customers want staged canary (1 node or 5% tenants), auto-revert on error spike, and a manual revert token.
elaine: Draft launch gates: 1) slimline + ops profiles; 2) preflight + docs; 3) minor in-place upgrade validated with canary + rollback; 4) allowlist doc security-reviewed; 5) major runbook drafted.
deploy-bot: Jira RDW-PRIV-901 created for "slimline+ops profiles + preflight".
elaine: Action items: jasper - installer templates + preflight (1w); frank - runbook + revert token prototype (2w); maria - recruit pilots (2w); netops - egress one-pager (1w). Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
